product.title: Ultrean Food Scale, Digital Kitchen Scale with LCD Display, Weight Grams and Ounces for Baking Cooking and Meal Prep, 6 Units with Tare Function, 304 Stainless Steel, 11lb (Batteries Included)

reviews.reviewTitle: Accurate and exacting. Cooking is a science, treat it as such! 🤓
reviews.reviewDescription: Perfect for our needs. I cook a lot but many recipes call for grams and other measurements I don’t have a clue about. This makes it easy. It’s small and easy to store (we tuck it in a cabinet on its side). It’s very accurate and I use it almost daily. I never thought I’d be one of those people but with cooking it does pay to be accurate as measuring cups differ. The price is so reasonable that it makes this a no brainer.
reviews.author: AFA7ZBQS7CCC6O6JGQAD7DBAKSZQ

reviews.reviewDescription: It’s small but very light! The button responsiveness is great. Very accurate so far and the color is very nice because make it look clean and professional. Versatile and looks like it will last me a while in terms of durability. 10/10 if you are looking for something light, small, functional.
reviews.author: AGHZF5SVOUITUR2AS33ZILCMVFBQ

reviews.reviewTitle: Good price for good capabilities. I only need to weight small items, so the compact size works.
reviews.reviewDescription: Small compact and easy to use. The LED readout can be adjusted to show measurements in your preferred measurement system ( i.e., lbs, ounces, or grams, Kilos). The battery is a flat battery the size of a nickle or a penny. These types of batteries can be pricier. For now, I'll assume this will last a long time. The small surface size of this scale, fits my limited kitchen counter space, and it works for the small items I need to weight such as the weight of one cabbage so that I can calculate the amount of salt to use to ferment it. I'm not sure how well this will work if you needed to weight a bag of apples, or a whole turkey.
reviews.author: AEEK7LLA4CSPLWXMYZY2AI7RZPRA

reviews.reviewTitle: small and won't take up a lot of room but can still weigh a LOT of weight for it's size
reviews.reviewDescription: very nice scales. works good. only (minor) gripe was it came with cheap, dead batteries.

reviews.reviewDescription: I needed a decent kitchen scale for my chocolate making hobby. It works perfectly, providing all the standard measurements you would expect. Most surprising is how small it is, it’s very thin. And yet it has an impressive weight capacity. All in all, it’s a fantastic, reliable scale, especially for the price.

reviews.reviewTitle: Highly recommend! Must have for weight control
reviews.reviewDescription: Must have if you are trying to watch your diets. I had no idea I had been so over-eating until I started logging my meals utilizing this scale. After visualizing how much each portion of food actually weight is a game changer for me to change eating pattern. It is compact, lightweight, and easy to use. The only inconvenience con is since its so small, I cannot really use my 211 plate to measure but use a bowl to weight my food first then transfer to my plate. I dont mind the extra effort since I like this scale so much.
reviews.author: AEPKEJNJM3CADSNGJMK7KSOCBEVQ
